name: preview-card-1z
title: Preview Card 1z: No card
author: tony <tony@spaceman.sh>
description: A catalogue card for showing a live component preview. There’s no card at all: a rounded preview tile with the name set beneath it, like an app icon.
docs: Every preview card design exports the same `PreviewCard` component, so you can switch designs by changing the import path. Pass the live preview as children.
